script.name: mongo_failover
script.objective: Kill the primary of a three-member replica set: a new one is elected and no majority-acknowledged write is lost.

script.name: mongo_secondary
script.objective: A read from a secondary sees a majority write within a bounded lag.

script.name: etcd_leader
script.objective: Kill the leader of a three-member etcd cluster: the client moves to the others and no write is lost.

script.name: cassandra_consistency
script.objective: Replication factor 3: with one node down ALL fails and QUORUM works; with two, QUORUM fails and ONE works.

script.name: redis_replica
script.objective: A replica follows its primary, refuses writes, and WAIT confirms replication.
